name: ZFC/FC diamagnetic transition and isothermal magnetization hysteresis loops of HgBa2Ca2Cu3O8 crystals with a SQUID-VSM, 10-115 K
plain_name: Measure how a high-temperature superconductor expels and traps magnetic field
description: Measure zero-field-cooled and field-cooled magnetization of a 0.41 mg Hg-1223 crystal at 10 Oe through Tc = 129 K, then isothermal magnetization loops (field along c, 10-115 K, dH/dt = 50 and 200 Oe/s) and dynamic relaxation in a Quantum Design SQUID-VSM.
keywords: Measure how a high-temperature superconductor expels and traps magnetic field

sources.citation: Y. Ye, Y. Liu, W. Hong, Y. Li, H.-H. Wen, 'Three Magnetization Peaks in HgBa2Ca2Cu3O8 Single Crystals', arXiv:2502.10737 (2025)

requirements.rationale: The magnetization was measured with a SQUID vibrating-sample magnetometer.
Magnetization loops were measured from 10 K to 115 K.
The ZFC/FC curves must pass through the onset Tc of 129 K, so the upper temperature must reach at least 129 K.
The 1.66 mm x 0.64 mm crystal has a circumscribed diameter of 1.78 mm (sqrt(1.66^2+0.64^2) = 1.779 mm, rounded up).
Optional: dynamic relaxation used sweep rates of 50 and 200 Oe/s.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
